paras: 03 Days Jaisalmer Tour Package
Tour Code #DR007
Rs.5899/- per person
Day 1: Arrival in Jaisalmer

Welcome to Jaisalmer - the golden city. At airport or railway station, our representative will welcome you and transfer you to your hotel. After some relaxation, we will start exploring the enchanting attractions of the city in the evening:
Gadisar Lake: Peaceful waters showingrich and golden history.
Vyas Chhatri: Architectural tribute to fictional legacy.
War Museum: Honoring bravery, preserving military tradition.
Enjoy an overnight stay at your hotel in Jaisalmer.
Day 2: Sightseeing & Desert Experience in Jaisalmer
After breakfast, we will visit the captivating monuments of Jaisalmer:
Jaisalmer Fort & Palaces: Royalty of Rajasthan.
Jain Temples: Intricate carvings, divine serenity.
Patwon Ki Haveli: Luxurious mansion of business heritage.
Nathmal Ki Haveli: Beautiful mixture of architectural charm.
Salim Singh Ki Haveli: Exclusive arches, attractive historical attraction.

In the evening, we will head to the Sam Sand Dunes for a unique experience of desert. Enjoy a memorable night in a tent with cultural programs, a wonderful camel ride, a spectacular sunset, and a traditional dinner.
Overnight stay at the Desert Camp, it will be a unique experience.
Day 3: Departure from Jaisalmer
After breakfast, we will check out from the desert camp and return to Jaisalmer. Before your departure, we will visit a few more fascinating sites:
Lodhruva: Antique beauty, everlasting spiritual feeling.
Amar Sagar: Peaceful waters, historic temple reflections.
Kuldhara: Unrestricted village, secretive haunting stories.
Badabagh: Royal cenotaphs within desert scene.
At the end of your tour, you will be dropped off at Jaisalmer Airport or Railway Station for your onward travel. End of Tour – Safe Travels!
Package Inclusions:
* Daily breakfast
* Air-conditioned car for transportation throughout the journey
* Driver allowance, fuel, parking fees, and all applicable taxes
* Accommodation in 3-star hotels
*Camel Ride, Bonfire, Hi-Tea, Cultural Programs & Vegetarian Dinner at Desert Camp
* Government-approved tourist guide service for sightseeing in Jaisalmer
* Complimentary accommodation for children below 5 years of age
Package Exclusions:
* Meals other than those specified in the inclusions
* Personal expenses such as tips, telephone calls, and laundry
* Entrance fees to monuments and attractions
* Camera fees
* Any tickets for trains, flights, or buses
* Travel insurance
Things to note
* Prices are quoted per person based on triple sharing.
* Rates may vary during peak seasons such as New Year and Diwali.
03 Days Jaipur,Khatushyam Ji & Salasar Balaji Tour Package
Tour Code #DR008
Rs.5499/- per person
Day 1: Arrival in Jaipur & Sightseeing

Welcome to Jaipur – Pink City! Upon your arrival at the airport or railway station, you will be transferred to your hotel, complete check-in process and rest for some time. Once settled, we will explore the vibrant attractions of the Pink City:
Hawa Mahal - The famous "Palace of Winds."
City Palace - A fabulous mixture of Rajasthani and Mughal culture.
Observatory / Jantar Mantar - Aremarkable collection of planetary instruments.
Jal Mahal - The beautiful "Water Palace."
Amer Fort - A majestic fort with stunning views.
Jaigarh Fort – Visit One of the best Palace in Jaipur City
In the evening, get pleasure from a traditional Rajasthani dinner at a resort, attended by pleasant folk music and cultural dances in a delightful village arrangement.
Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaipur.
Day 2: Visit Khatu Shyam Ji, Jeen Mata Ji & Salasar Bala Ji
After having your breakfast, we will start a spiritual journey to visit some revered holy sites of Rajasthan:
Khatu Shyam Ji: Commitment and wonders happen here.
Jeen Mata Ji: Heavenly blessings at holy shrine.
Salasar Bala Ji: Trust and worship unite visitors.
We will return to Jaipur by evening, where you will enjoy another restful night at your hotel.
Day 3: Departure from Jaipur
After breakfast, you will be dropped off at Jaipur Airport or Railway Station for your journey.
End of Tour – Safe Travels!

03 Days Udaipur Tour Package
Tour Code #DR010
Rs.5699/- per person
Day 1: Arrival in Udaipur

Welcome to Udaipur! Get a warm welcome from our representative and our representative will help you to reach to your hotel. After taking some rest, we will go to explore some wonderful attractions of the Lake City:
City Palace - A majestic complex with stunning architecture and rich history
Jagdish Temple - An antique and beautifully carved temple devoted to Lord Vishnu
Bagore Ki Haveli – A unique experience of antique architecture
Saheliyon Ki Bari - A beautiful garden decorated with fountains and marble pavilions
In the evening, enjoy a peaceful boat ride on Lake Pichola to witness a gorgeous sunset.
Overnight stay at your hotel in Udaipur.
Day 2: Sightseeing in Udaipur
After having your breakfast, we will visit some of most captivating sites of Udaipur:
Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal: Representing rich culture of India.
Shilpgram: Haven of rural arts and crafts.
Pratap Smarak: Honoring valorous warrior spirit of Rajput.
Karni Mata Ropeway: Picturesque ride to heavenly heights.
Overnight stay at your hotel in Udaipur.
